description: Three-topic sanity case. Geometry directions are synthetic test data, not model quality evidence.

documents.text: Parallel programming divides work across processors. Parallel speedup is the execution time on one processor divided by the time using multiple processors. Amdahl's law limits speedup when a portion of the program remains serial.
TCP provides reliable ordered delivery of bytes over a network. Sequence numbers, acknowledgments and retransmission recover lost packets. Congestion control adjusts the sender's transmission rate.
Financial accounting records business transactions. The accounting equation states that assets equal liabilities plus equity. Revenue minus expenses determines profit in an income statement.

queries.query: How much faster can a program run when work is distributed across processors?
How does a connection recover lost packets and deliver data in order?
What relationship links a company's assets, debts and owners' equity?
